svg.aria-label: Left, an attention head multiplies Q, n by d_h, with K transposed, d_h by n, so the n by n score matrix has rank at most d_h, about 128, however long the sequence. Right, multi-head latent attention projects each hidden state h of width 7168 down to a latent c of width 512 and only caches c, with per-head up projections producing K and V, which can be folded into the query at decode time.
svg.text: every attention head is already low rank
rank ≤ d_h (like 128), even when n is a million,
so a head can only express d_h directions of "match"
the KV cache holds only cₜ
not every head's K and V
W_up can be folded into the query,
so decode reads the latent directly
